for_the_board: OPERATOR DECISION, raised as cards/NEW-card-8-injected-docs-gate.json: make check-injected-docs a BLOCKING stage of make validate. Card #8 recommends yes. The measured false-positive rate on the current tree is 0, and 14 real drifts accumulated in the injected docs while nothing ran the checker. The cost: a commit that moves an anchored line must update the citing doc and anchors.tsv in the same commit, and the land gate runs validate. Not wired here, per Helios's ruling. Helios assigns the NEW card's id and places it in goal.json.
